package.name: x30_inspection
package.description: Substation inspection at the stop points of the X30's patrol (the HotDog pattern on ROS Noetic): the HIKMICRO PTZ camera is pointed at each piece of equipment taught there and its temperatures are judged for overheating (absolute, ambient and similar criteria), the Hertzino HZ-FA-371 listens for partial discharge, and a report with the thermal, visible, sound map and PRPD images is kept on the robot and published.
